result.summary: The page is generally cohesive, but there are a few visible clipping and contrast issues affecting polish and readability.

issues.description: The horizontal category row and “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel are visibly cut off at the right edge, with partial chips/cards shown and no clear scrolling affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding and a visible carousel cue, or ensure items are intentionally clipped with clear swipe behavior and indicators.

issues.description: The second restaurant card near the bottom is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation, making its content appear abruptly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or adjust the navigation overlay so the full card can be viewed before reaching the bottom.

issues.description: The white promotional text on the pale mint banner has low contrast, especially the smaller subtitle, making it harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Use darker text or a stronger background tint while maintaining the promotional styling.
